name: Rasa Juknevičienė - Après le § 64 - Am 10
title: REPORT on Hybrid warfare and the protection of the EU’s territorial integrity and critical security and defence infrastructure
part_text: 64a. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to suspend EU funding, financial assistance and preferential financing to any third country or organisation whose administration deliberately encourages, facilitates, directs or instrumentalises illegal immigration flows as part of a hybrid attack against a Member State; considers that, in the light of the events of 30 and 31 July 2026 in the Spanish city of Ceuta, the Commission should urgently review all EU funding provided to Morocco for migration management and border control;
